svg.title: Partner Webhook Relay topology
svg.desc: Producer calls an IAM-protected Event API. A Firestore outbox precedes a partner-specific Cloud Tasks queue and OIDC Cloud Run worker. The worker sends an HMAC-signed HTTPS event to a public synthetic partner simulator which writes create-only receipts to Cloud Storage. Cloud Scheduler invokes a reconciler; Firestore keeps the durable event and delivery ledger. Secret Manager holds partner keys.
svg.text: Asynchronous delivery • durable outbox • at-least-once retries • idempotent partner receipt
Operator (Cloud Shell): inspect ledger, queue metadata and receipt; redrive writes actor + reason, increments generation, then Reconciler enqueues.
Cloud Logging stores structured metadata only; Cloud Monitoring alerts on stale outbox and retry_ended_unknown. No payload, key, token or full signature in logs.
Partner B is a Change Request: separate queue, HMAC secret, simulator service identity and receipt bucket. Arrows show control/data flows; lines are not a claim of GCP execution.
